---
title: "Stage 5 – Your own project"
---
The route ends on a project of your own, on a question beyond the claim that SCORE selected from the paper, chosen from the [list below](#the-projects). The preregistration of the project is complete before anything in it runs, and it is fixed with a date that someone else can check, either as the first commit of the repository of the project, pushed to GitHub, or as a registration on OSF Registries. The stage takes about six and a quarter hours of work, and is best spread over several sittings.

## 1. Version control

[Open Git and GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-why){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Work through the module on git and GitHub on the AR4DS site, from [Version control](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-why) to [GitHub](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-github).

## 2. The preregistration of the project

[Open the preregistration templates](../../companion/repositories.qmd#sec-prereg-templates){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The section on registrations describes two templates, the AsPredicted form and the template for secondary data. Write the preregistration of your project with one of them, with a data-in-hand statement that says what you have already looked at in the data. Make it the first commit of a new repository and push it to GitHub, or register it on OSF Registries, before you run anything.

## 3. What to track

[Open What to track](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-repro){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read [What to track](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-repro) and [Your own reanalysis](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-application). Add your case-study report to the repository, with the workspace that renders it. The `.gitignore` file of the workspace keeps out its `data_private/` folder, which holds your respondent file.

## 4. Your project

**In the repository of your project.** Run the specification that you declared, and that one first. Report its result as your preregistration said you would, and place it beside the curve of the case study where it can be placed. Label anything that you add after seeing the result as exploratory, and commit as you go.

## 5. Depositing the project

[Open Depositing a reanalysis](../../companion/repositories.qmd#sec-deposit){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

Read the section, and write the README of your repository by the route that it sets out.

## 6. Publishing (optional)

[Open Quarto projects](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-project){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

Read [Projects](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-project) and [Publishing the document](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/tools/quarto.html#sec-publish) in the module on Quarto on the AR4DS site. Render your case-study report and the project together as one Quarto project, and publish the rendered output where other people can reach it.

**Shortcuts.** If you already use git and GitHub, skip the first step and read [What to track](https://codemoreh.github.io/ar4ds/git-github.html#sec-repro) for what the licence of the Eurobarometer files keeps out of a repository.

## The projects {#the-projects}

Each item names a direction that the data and the pages of the case study support. The question, the specification and the rule by which the result is judged are yours to declare.

- **The negative scales.** You can take the other half of the first hypothesis of the paper, a rise in negative framing, on the negative scales. Start from [The negative scales](../../curve.qmd#negative-scales) on the Specification curve page.
- **A different estimand.** You can take the average European in place of the average member state, with the population weight, or the years before the crisis, the crisis years, or the member states without the bailout countries. Start from [Whose average](../../menu.qmd#whose-average) on the Specification menu page, and [Heterogeneity and influence](../../companion/multiverse.qmd#sec-heterogeneity) in the multiverse module.
- **The second claim of the paper.** You can take the gap between education groups on the respondent file that you built in stage 3, which never leaves your machine, or on the panel by education band, which ships with the course. Start from [the panel by education band](../../companion/data-management.qmd#sec-edu).
- **Later waves.** You can take the claim to later Eurobarometer waves, such as those of 2013 to 2019 on which the SCORE replication tested it, with the data built by you from the files at GESIS by the route of stage 3. The course has no unit on these waves. Start from [the replication](../../background.qmd#sec-repetition) on the background page, [the GESIS archive](../../companion/data-sources.qmd#sec-gesis) in the module on data sources, and [Building the analysis file](../../companion/data-management.qmd).
